ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #12
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 100 °C

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Precautions when using? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Precautions when using.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Precautions when using.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Precautions when using.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Precautions when using.

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

4. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Removing all vegetation

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transporting? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transporting.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transporting.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Transporting.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transporting.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Recording weather? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Recording weather.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Recording weather.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Recording weather.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Recording weather.

8. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Iron rusting

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Forming shadows in light? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Forming shadows in light.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Forming shadows in light.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Forming shadows in light.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Forming shadows in light.

10. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Only water vapour

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Light its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Light its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Light its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Light its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Light its resources.

12. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil and its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Soil and its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil and its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil and its resources.

14. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

15. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

16. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Decomposers only

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpreting? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpreting.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Interpreting.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpreting.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpreting.

18. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying School environment environment? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to School environment environment.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on School environment environment.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for School environment environment.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about School environment environment.

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety when handling? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when handling.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety when handling.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Safety when handling.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety when handling.

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Weather its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather its resources.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Forming shadows in light and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Precautions when using and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain School environment environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

31. In three clear sentences, explain School rules and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

32. In three clear sentences, explain Class Leadership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
